==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|carefull||obsolete}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*ǵeh₂r-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|careful}}, from {{inh|en|ang|carful}}; equivalent to {{suffix|en|care|-ful|pos=adjective}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɛɹfəl/|[ˈkɛɹfəɫ]|[ˈkɛɹfɫ̩]|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɛːfl̩/|[ˈkɛːfɫ̩]|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-careful.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛːfəl|ɛəɹfəl|s=2}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|more}}

# Taking care; [[attentive]] to [[potential]] [[danger]], [[error]] or [[harm]]; [[cautious]].
#: {{ux|en|He was a slow and '''careful''' driver.}}
#: {{ux|en|Be very '''careful''' (while) trekking through the jungle.}}
#* {{RQ:NYT|author=Anemona Hartocollis|date=Feb. 3, 2025|title=The University of California Increased Diversity. Now It’s Being Sued.|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/02/03/us/affirmative-action-california.html|passage=John Aubrey Douglass, a senior research fellow at the Center for Studies in Higher Education at Berkeley, said that while he was not an insider on admissions practices, “my sense is that admissions is highly regulated and '''careful''' to stay clear of Prop 209 restrictions, and the Supreme Court’s ruling on affirmative action.”|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250907201443/https://www.nytimes.com/2025/02/03/us/affirmative-action-california.html|archivedate=7 September 2025}}
# {{U|conscientious}} and [[painstaking]]; [[meticulous]].
#: {{ux|en|They made a '''careful''' search of the crime scene.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} Full of [[care]] or [[grief]]; [[sorrowful]], [[sad]].
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} Full of [[cares]] or [[anxiety]]; [[worried]], [[troubled]].
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|passage=Where through long watch, and late daies weary toile, / She soundly slept, and '''carefull''' thoughts did quite assoile.|3|1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|deliberate}}
* See also [[Thesaurus:cautious]]
* See also [[Thesaurus:meticulous]]

====Antonyms====
* {{l|en|careless}}
